lines.1: That night, at a ramen stall by Matsukasa Station--
lines.6: 「You're the exchange student from Class 2-C, right?」
lines.7: 「My shop wanted a new challenge, ne. So we opened stall and I work part-time. Nice to meet you from now on, ne.」
lines.9: 「Don't just say 'kuu.' Only we in 2-A understand you. Get in the habit of actually pronouncing words.」
lines.10: 「Salt ramen for her. Add an egg too.」
lines.11: 「Murata, you're way too soft on Noriko.」
lines.12: 「If you always make things easy for her, Noriko's the one who'll suffer later. There--sound logic.」
lines.13: 「We can at least enjoy a meal in peace, can't we?」
lines.14: 「What a soft big brother. No wonder all twelve of your little sisters love you.」
lines.15: 「Hm? Want an introduction? One of them doesn't mind girls either.」
lines.16: 「I'm a Kurogane-senpai fan, so I'll pass.」
lines.21: 「No, Noriko! Not 'kuu'! This is exactly when you say it properly. I-ta-da-ki-ma-su!」
lines.24: 「See? Murata's always too soft on you... Whatever. Let's eat before it gets soggy.」
lines.26: 「Munch munch... Mmm. I can't get enough of how heavy this is.」
lines.28: 「You know, you eat pretty wildly. Doesn't really match how you usually act.」
lines.29: 「So what? I have manners. Kurogane-senpai says a maiden should eat food with gusto like this.」
lines.31: Plop. (The egg slipped from her chopsticks.)
lines.36: 「What a klutz, Noriko. That's what happens when you space out.」
lines.38: 「Here. You're a klutz, so eat an egg and put some nutrients in your brain.」
lines.39: Konoe gave Nishizaki her own egg.
lines.44: 「What are you grinning about? You're getting on my nerves.」
lines.45: 「For all your complaining, you're a good person.」
lines.46: 「...What's with that out of nowhere!? I just took pity on her.」
lines.48: 「Of course THIS is when you speak clearly! Give me my egg back!」
lines.54: 「Apparently that's a stock comedy exchange from Kansai.」
lines.55: 「By the way, didn't you invite me because there was something you wanted to ask?」
lines.56: 「Ah... You'll get mad if I say it, so another time.」
lines.59: 「Honestly... What did he even want to ask?」
lines.60: 「Well, the ramen was good, so whatever.」
